Libraries bundled in rapidoc-10.1.0.min.js (RapiDoc 10.1.0, https://github.com/rapi-doc/RapiDoc), with their licenses.
The bundle keeps their license comments (lit). Versions are those RapiDoc 10.1.0 depends on.
